label: Kosovo heard as a name and written down
description: A name he says he kept hearing and did not recognise, which the Lord told him to write down, prayed over for a long time, given alongside a major world war across Europe with weapons not seen before. He says he does not know what it means and calls himself a country boy who does not know this stuff.
aliases: This is a name I keep hearing
the Lord said, Write it down
I prayed over Kosovo for a long time today

label: Success comes from the hand of the Lord, not ability
description: A warning that pride can set in and produce anger and bitterness, with the point that the man is successful like David's mighty men only because the hand of the Lord was on him rather than because he is good.
aliases: pride to set in and get angry and bitter
You're only successful like David's mighty men of war because the hand of the Lord was on you

label: Do not strong-arm it: let it be a vote and walk light
description: Advice given as from the spirit: let it be a vote, be strategic and do not strong-arm this, be cautious concerning the European Union no matter how right it looks for the picking, be diplomatic rather than dictatorial and do not be the bully in the schoolyard, walking light with Europe and praying for hearts.
aliases: Don't be strong-arming this
Don't be the bully in the school yard
No matter how much it looks right for the picking, be cautious

label: Russia is too depleted from Ukraine to defend it

aliases: they're too weak to defend it

he has a big voice, but it's a demonic spirit speaking through his voice

label: Certain cryptocurrencies called to five dollars

label: The cartel pays young men to raise an army against American troops
description: Young men in Venezuela paid off by the drug cartel to raise an army against American troops already on the ground there, oriented toward Brazil, with Cuba seen devising a plan to create civil unrest.

label: His attitude toward his wife was blocking him in the spirit
description: He says he was told he had to fix something because when he was blocking in the spirit he could not get to the other side of it, asked what was blocking him, and was told it was his attitude toward his wife. He apologises and says he is being public about it.
aliases: what is blocking me?
your attitude towards your wife
